clips.speaker: Bloomberg
clips.title: 美伊临时协议达成 霍尔木兹海峡有望重开
title_lines: 霍尔木兹海峡有望重开
油价暴跌 航运恢复仍需时日
title_highlights: 霍尔木兹海峡有望重开

subtitles.en: Oil prices are tumbling after the US and Iran said they reached an interim agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. When and if shipping returns to normal through the waterway is a different
subtitles.zh: 美国与伊朗达成临时协议重新开放霍尔木兹海峡，油价应声下跌。但航运何时恢复正常仍是未知数。

subtitles.en: matter. Brent Oil was trading below $85 a barrel at the start of the week. To put that in context, at the height of the war, it topped $125 a barrel. But lots of uncertainties remain,
subtitles.zh: 布伦特原油本周初跌破每桶85美元，而战争高峰时曾高达125美元。但不确定性犹存。

subtitles.en: particularly as there's still a few days until the deal will be signed. Ship owners are busy seeking clarity on what a reopening might look like. Questions over transit fees, delays, and safety will all
subtitles.zh: 协议签署尚需数日，船东们急于了解重新开放的具体细节，包括通行费、延误和安全问题。

subtitles.en: need to be addressed to give ship owners the confidence to resume crossing Hormuz. There's also anxiety over mines which atop trade groups says remains a critical detail and a backlog of
subtitles.zh: 水雷风险仍是关键问题，贸易组织称这需要解决。等待通行的船只积压可能需数周才能消化。

subtitles.en: ships waiting to transit the waterway could also take weeks to work through. But if Hormuz does reopen, it would mean more oil on the market and put an end to any concern about an energy crisis.
subtitles.zh: 若霍尔木兹海峡重新开放，将增加市场石油供应，消除能源危机担忧。
